entities.summary: Ariana Harwicz is an Argentine writer, screenwriter, playwright and documentary maker. She earned a degree in performing arts from the University of Paris VII and a Master's in comparative literature from the Sorbonne. Her first novel, Matate, amor (2012), was translated into English as Die, My Love and was longlisted for the 2018 Man Booker International Prize. La débil mental (2014) was translated as Feebleminded. Her works have been translated into more than ten languages.
